scope: T5.1 canon 30-34 simultaneous CareerOffer authority handoff

consumers.canonicalNeed: Represent four simultaneous late-career routes/proposals without collapsing them into one pending offer.

currentRuntime.rule: The plural read API does not imply plural persistence; it currently projects zero-or-one pending CareerOffer.

requiredCapabilities: Persist more than one simultaneously active formal CareerOffer with stable identity and exact provenance per offer.
Read all currently eligible formal offers deterministically without consuming narrative RNG or mutating GameState.
Address accept, counter, defer and reject by exact offer identity so a response cannot accidentally target a sibling offer.
Preserve the complete simultaneous offer set and each offer's lifecycle/provenance through save and restore.
Define an explicit shared-authority disposition for non-selected sibling offers; this workstream does not invent whether they remain, expire, withdraw or reject automatically.
Keep offer terms and contract application owned by CareerOffer/market authority rather than narrative effects, flags, tags or seeds.
Maintain deterministic replay/idempotence: retrying the same response command cannot resolve a different sibling offer or apply a contract twice.
Provide migration behavior for saves using the current singleton pending field without fabricating simultaneous offers that did not historically exist.
prohibitedApproximations: Calling getEligibleCareerOffers() multi-offer support while it is backed by a singleton pending field.
Encoding the second/third/fourth offer only in event choice text.
Encoding alternative offers as HAS_SEED_* or arbitrary flags.
Synthesizing offer terms from club prestige, reputation, age or route labels.
Reusing one CareerOffer id for multiple canonical proposals.
Applying club/contract state directly from a narrative outcome to bypass offer identity.
codexAcceptanceEvidence: Persistence test with at least two simultaneously active offers having distinct ids and terms; both survive save/restore exactly.
Four-offer capacity test demonstrating the authority can represent the cardinality required by EVT_33_MKT_001 without narrative-side shadow state.
Exact-target response tests proving accept/counter/defer/reject operate on the selected offer id and do not mutate an unintended sibling.
Retry/idempotence test for response commands in a multi-offer state.
Deterministic eligibility/read-order test consuming zero narrative RNG.
Legacy singleton-save migration test preserving the historical pending offer exactly and creating no phantom siblings.
Negative tests proving choice text, flags, seeds and prestige cannot stand in for a persisted formal offer.
integrationOrder: Freeze/register the current 30-34 target before content changes that would create another identity.
Shared market/contract owner implements and migrates multi-offer persistence plus exact response addressing.
Canonical owners provide exact proposal terms and any sibling-disposition semantics not already authoritative.
Only then bridge EVT_31_MKT_001 and EVT_33_MKT_001 to the shared authority in a coordinated content-identity batch.
